input.quote: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: Customer has a rolling convenience right after a 12-month Initial Term on 90 days' notice, which sits at the fallback (60–90 days), and Kubient's mirror right is also at 90 days' notice, so neither walk-away trigger applies. There is no early-termination fee (Kubient simply keeps revenue-share fees generated during the notice period). We separately propose shortening our notice to 30 days under the renewal rule.
